name: com.howmacro.unity
description: Compile-time macros for C# in Unity. A macro is ordinary C#: the IDE sees a normal method call or attribute; at compile time an ILPostProcessor expands it, and only the expanded code reaches the player.

samples.description: Everyday macros on one MonoBehaviour: @COLORLOG (a field that logs each change in color), [@Get] auto GetComponent, [@Save] PlayerPrefs saving, [@Watch] a live debug box. Add ColorLogDemo to a Cube.
[@Command] debug buttons registered by generated startup code, a [@Watch] overlay, @ASSERT compiled out of release builds. Menu: HowMacro > Create Demo Scene.

@CLAMPED properties over serialized fields, PlayerPrefs saving with [@Save], tag and layer names checked at compile time. Needs the tag Enemy and the layers Ground and Enemy (see its README). Menu: HowMacro > Create Arena Scene.
